content: OMG, guys, I just wanna like, hold this boy’s hand. Seriously, like, even if it's not even him specifically, I just wanna hold A boy’s hand, you feel me? Like, at the hall, yeah, and just stand there like I'm lined up against the walls of public rejection, and all the normies just harsh judging me for being who I am. Like, why do they even care though? Why all the hate just for us loving? Isn’t it super ironic or something? It’s so bizarre, like, hearing people just casually dropping insults like we aren't even there. I swear, any minuscule chance at a social life I had before? TOTAL bread slicer obliteration if I burst out of this cage. But like, why can't I just be a cute girly boy? What's wrong with that, I ask? Why is it so cringe for them but, hold up, super valid to me?!
